test_title: PYST 30: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 10 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B. B sits third to the left of X. W sits third to the left of Y. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and X. How many people sit between D and C when counted from the right of D?
solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only four people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B.

2) B sits third to the left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac569145ddb8d6f01d5972f94a41a0803d42e4a54e9d6806ad6720a085902153.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b6633e6832d7290e86eb2a9cacbdd3a4224f64cf1a5bf66310007e81bf5ed0b.png] 

3) W sits third to the left of Y.

4) C is an immediate neighbour of both A and X.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/262a2ded4df935309a594180b44cbc8eb825e7da8d45400e6393dce1142cc822.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6dde16f2e3fd1c8bac08c86301f77ae48a860c4bea7be11d430a9366561604.png] 

Thus, two people sit between D and C when counted from the right of D.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
